svg.title: What a GarageGraph Vertex is
svg.desc: A Vertex is an index into the Boost adjacency list's vertex vector. Each entry stores the pose (node + heading) and the vertex's out- and in-edge lists; a hash map translates poses to indices.

g.text: Vertex numbers and edges recomputed from the Pecos YAML with the PoseGraph rules (nodes by id, headings ascending, h and h+180). Out-edge order inside Boost is insertion order, which follows the neighbour slots; the lists here are sorted. Headings are int16 in [-179, 180] (GaragePose.msg), so the reciprocal

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: of 90 is -90 and it sorts first. Map labels: P17, W22, B21, C14 = node_id 17, 22, 21, 14 (P parking, W waypoint, B bay, C AGV charger); T17 = tray_id 17; A, B = AGVs; X@90 = GaragePose {node_id: X, heading: 90}, heading in degrees [-179, 180], 90 = facing -x.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Vertex is BoostPoseGraph::vertex_descriptor: with vecS storage, a plain std::size_t index into the graph's vertex vector. The pose lives in that vector entry; pose_to_vertex_ is the reverse map. Vertex 44 is the pose {node_id: 22, heading: 90}; W22 lists headings 0 and
